alaska.note: 14 mainland sheets. Western Aleutians East is EXCLUDED: despite FAA's East/West split it still straddles the antimeridian (177E..-172W), which one web-mercator warp cannot express; its unique area past Attu is open ocean. TODO: split that scan at 180 into two units to recover it.

caribbean.note: Separate FAA product line (visual/<cycle>/Caribbean/), not sectional-files. Puerto Rico + Virgin Islands + Lesser Antilles at 1:1M. CONUS sectionals (1:500k) outrank it over south Florida; see scripts/make-yield.py.

aleutians_west.note: East longitudes. Includes the EAST scan's 177E-180 half; its other half (180 to -172.35W, which holds Adak) is region aleutians_far. The scan straddles the antimeridian, so it is processed as two windows.

mariana.note: Shipped inside the Hawaiian Islands zip as its own georeferenced scan.

samoa.note: Shipped inside the Hawaiian Islands zip as its own georeferenced scan.

aleutians_far.note: The Western Aleutians East scan west of the antimeridian: Adak (PADK), Atka.
